doctor.title: Diagnose download
doctor.description: Based on the engine error recorded in the local journal.
doctor.quarantined.title: File is quarantined
doctor.guard.title: Quarantined by Download Guard
doctor.guard.summary: The file is a dangerous type or its content doesn't match its name. UTD didn't move it to your download folder.
doctor.guard.steps:
Open %LOCALAPPDATA%\UTD-Data\quarantine to see the held file.
Only restore it if you know and trust where it came from.
Download it again from the official site if it's an installer or script.
doctor.hash.title: Hash mismatch
doctor.hash.summary: The downloaded content doesn't match the expected SHA-256. The file may be corrupted or modified.
doctor.hash.steps:
Check the SHA-256 again from the official source.
Remove this item and download from scratch, without resuming.
If the hash still differs, don't run the file; contact the publisher.
doctor.limited.title: Server is rate limiting
doctor.limited.summary: The server is limiting requests. UTD retried but couldn't finish.
doctor.limited.steps:
Wait a few minutes, then click Resume; UTD lowers the number of connections by itself.
Check your network, VPN or proxy if it keeps happening.
doctor.network.title: Network interrupted
doctor.network.summary: The connection to the server is unstable. UTD retried but couldn't finish.
doctor.network.steps:
Check your network, VPN or proxy, then click Resume.
If the server reports 429, wait a few minutes, then click Resume; UTD lowers the number of connections by itself.
doctor.access.title: Access required
doctor.access.summary: The server refused access or asked for a sign-in. This version doesn't send sign-in cookies or headers.
doctor.access.steps:
Open the URL in your browser to check access.
Use a public download link or a link whose token is still valid.
Don't download private or paid content without permission.
doctor.gone.title: Source no longer exists
doctor.gone.summary: The server couldn't find the file, or the video was removed.
doctor.gone.steps:
Check the URL again in your browser.
Look for a newer release or an official mirror.
doctor.drm.title: DRM-protected content
doctor.drm.summary: UTD doesn't bypass copy protection. This limit is intentional.
doctor.drm.steps:
Use the platform's official download feature if it's allowed.
Don't use DRM-cracking tools.
doctor.tool.title: Media tool missing
doctor.tool.summary: UTD needs yt-dlp/ffmpeg to download or merge media. Copies already on your computer are used as is.
doctor.tool.steps:
Open Settings → Media tools and click “Get yt-dlp” or “Get ffmpeg”.
UTD downloads the official build from GitHub and checks its SHA-256 before use.
When it's installed, click Resume.
doctor.mux.title: Couldn't merge media
doctor.mux.summary: ffmpeg couldn't merge the downloaded video and audio.
doctor.mux.steps:
Update ffmpeg in Settings → Media tools.
Remove this item and download again; you can pick another quality.
doctor.lostParts.title: Downloaded streams are missing
doctor.lostParts.summary: The video/audio files UTD downloaded for merging can't be found.
doctor.lostParts.steps:
Click Resume to download the missing parts again.
Don't delete temporary files in the download folder while media is unfinished.
doctor.disk.title: Disk write error
doctor.disk.summary: The file couldn't be written. The disk may be full or the file locked by another program.
doctor.disk.steps:
Check free disk space and write permission for the folder.
Close antivirus software that is scanning the temporary file.
Click Resume after freeing up space.
doctor.exists.title: Destination file already exists
doctor.exists.steps:
Rename the destination file or choose another folder.
Delete the old file if you're sure you don't need it.
doctor.unsupported.title: URL not supported yet
doctor.unsupported.summary: yt-dlp found no suitable media stream at this URL.
doctor.unsupported.steps:
Check that the URL is a public video page.
If the site changed recently, an old yt-dlp may not read it: Settings → Media tools → Update.
Try downloading the file directly if you have an MP4/HLS link.
doctor.unknown.title: Cause not identified
doctor.unknown.summary: UTD has no specific diagnosis for this error yet. Try resuming or downloading again from scratch.
doctor.unknown.steps:
Click Resume to retry; UTD keeps the progress saved in the journal.
If the error repeats, check the URL, your network and disk space.
Don't run the file if you don't know where it came from.

privacy.title: Safety & privacy
privacy.description: No telemetry, no cloud. Suspicious files are quarantined.
